### Fixed

- *(model-serving)* VLLM's cache is a subPath of the claim's own — .vllm-cache at the claim root mounted at /mnt/vllm-cache on the runtime container, VLLM_CACHE_ROOT set in the same rule — never a path under the model's directory in [#542](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/542) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
